answer: Stylometric fingerprint clustering resists sybils: the system fingerprints each identity's writing style across answers and flags clusters of identities sharing one statistical style signature — the tell of a single generator behind many accounts. A relic set of fakes from one model collapses into a tight stylometric cluster; an echo of the same phrasing habits across supposedly-distinct agents is the signature. Genuine independent agents scatter across style space like quartz facets; the dense single-author cluster routes its members to a targeted lane re-grade and weight discount.
